# Capture checklist: Animals

<!-- Generated by `node core/bin/capture.ts build` from data/vocab/types.json and core/src/schema/capture/properties.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

R is required for Usable, R? is required when its condition holds, A is applicable (counts for Complete). Properties not listed are never asked. Suitability paths are listed under their profile; the full list for a type is `node core/bin/capture.ts fields --type <id>`.

## Riding (`animals.ride`)

Records: offer. Suitability profile `horse` (always, extension horse). Effort: operator. Sources, in order: O.

**offer (experience)**: R name, type, summary, season, hours, price, class_key, draw, standing, distinction, easy_payoff, weather, why, signals, links, at, run_by, duration_min, activity_min, book_url; R? window (bookable); A names, best_time, transit, pairs_with, closures, photos, on, cancellation, included.

Suitability: R min_age, min_weight_kg, max_weight_kg, limit_reason, adult_required, age_band, kid_note, on_site_min, access_season, participation.wear, participation.pregnancy, participation.waiver, ext.horse.lead_rein; R when operated none; A effort.drivers.distance_km, toilets, exposure, participation.kit_provided, participation.medical, participation.weigh_in, participation.weather_cancel, ext.horse.share_horse, ext.horse.pace, ext.horse.pony_option.

Links: official; R? none; A hours_rates, booking, accessibility.
